properties.name: Burnaby Heights / Confederation Park edge
properties.description:
Good: Hastings shops, park access, and house-form streets.
Bad: Hastings traffic; northern park trails are steep. Views vary by home.
properties.source: Owner-requested inlet-side addition, 2026-10-23; BC Address Geocoder anchors and cited municipal context. See docs/inlet-pockets.md.
properties.geometry_method: Carleton North/Oxford, Oxford/Penzance/Willingdon North, and Carleton/Willingdon at Hastings. Straight street-to-street envelope west of Confederation Park.
properties.boundary_accuracy: Approximate residential search outline; not an official neighbourhood boundary, measured walk, or guaranteed waterfront access.

properties.name: Capitol Hill / Cambridge ridge
properties.description:
Good: Quiet residential streets and potential inlet or mountain views.
Bad: Hills and a longer walk to shops; the view depends on the unit.
properties.source: Owner-requested inlet-side addition, 2026-10-23; BC Address Geocoder anchors and cited municipal context. See docs/inlet-pockets.md.
properties.geometry_method: Hythe North/Grosvenor North at Cambridge and Dundas. A compact ridge pocket, not a blanket north-slope or waterfront polygon.
properties.boundary_accuracy: Approximate residential search outline; not an official neighbourhood boundary, measured walk, or guaranteed waterfront access.

properties.name: College Park / Easthill residential pocket
properties.description:
Good: House-form options, nearby green space, and potential inlet views.
Bad: Hills; shops, stations, and the waterfront may require a longer trip.
properties.source: Owner-requested inlet-side addition, 2026-10-23; BC Address Geocoder anchors and cited municipal context. See docs/inlet-pockets.md.
properties.geometry_method: Oxford/Princeton, College Park/Oxford, Cecile/College Park, and Princeton/McMaster corners. Straight connecting edges enclose part of the residential hill; they are not park boundaries or measured walking catchments.
